1.consolidated_definition: Deducible, pago compartido. Suma o tanto por ciento complementario que debe pagar una persona, especialmente por concepto de servicios recibidos en seguros médicos u hospitalarios. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Usted puede recibir un suministro de 90 días de medicinas genéricas para un $10 copayment contra la medicina de nombre de marca para un $35 copayment (Cruz Azul, consultado 30-03-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Deductible payment, shared cost. Additional sum or percentage that a person must pay, especially for medical or hospital services received under insurance policies. Raw anglicism, relatively uncommon. You may receive a 90-day supply of generic medicines for a $10 copayment against the branded medicine copayment of $35 (Cruz Azul, consulted on March 30, 2008)
